reviews.title: Get this!!!
reviews.comment: This fan works amazingly. It was pretty straight forward to install, you might need a video but I winged it. They look really nice and expensive, my cpu would stay around 28° and got rid of a lot of heat out of the pc. Compatibility was great
reviews.author: Kristina

reviews.title: Silent and efficient
reviews.comment: Very good product. Under light loads it's almost silent. Under heavier loads, for obvious reasons, it does make quite a bit of noise, though still considerable, but acceptable, especially considering its ability to handle very good temperatures for a Ryzen 9 9950x. I'm very sensitive to noise, as my hearing is very sensitive and I hear many things that other people don't, and this cooler has been an excellent purchase because it only makes noise with the fans and only does so when it really needs to.
reviews.author: Nicolas

reviews.title: Solid non rgb AIO
reviews.comment: Needed to upgrade as my 240 wasn't cutting it. Relatively easy to mount and the spring screws are nice. It does a good job of keeping my CPU cool especially as its getting warmer in my office. It worked with my 5900X which was nice. Price was decent. I also don'pt mind that it wasn't RGB. Fit perfectly inside my LianLI case.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: I got this when I rebuilt my media center again with a newer system board and everything.  My previous one also was liquid cooled so I preferred that for the noise levels. Since I used a frame case rather than a normal enclosed case, I had no issues with fitting.  Dead silent in use even when everything else in my great room is turned off and it's dead silent on there. No temp issues with the media center computer even when it's busy with 4k content.
reviews.author: LegoDude

reviews.title: Great cooler
reviews.comment: 10m after opening the box, the installation was done. The unit's cooling is quite good, significantly better under a heavy load than the unit it replaced.
